svg.title: iOS · Settings · Libraries · Remove from this iPhone (confirm) · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors the Libraries card's long-press Remove from this iPhone… (App/SettingsView.swift, librariesCardPhone: askToRemove → phoneRemoving; the confirmationDialog) over LibraryRemoval.check — libraries plan L25, C2c (2026-09-17, code first; drawn from the code, the guard verified on the Simulator). The check first, off the main actor: every project folder's heavy files (PicPlaceSyncInventory over PicPlaceSyncRun.listFiles) against its sync record — held on PicPlace when serverHeavyFiles covers them or originalsMovedAt is set. When nothing exists only here, THIS SHEET: 'Remove “Holidays” from this iPhone?' and the numbers — '877 previews go. 3 projects' originals here go — PicPlace holds them. The library stays on PicPlace and on your other devices.' ('It is empty.' for an empty one; 'Nothing is on PicPlace for it.' for an unbound one, which can only pass the guard when it holds no originals). Remove (destructive) deletes the folder — StorageRoot.removeLibraryFolder, never the open library — and the card refreshes; Cancel. When a project's originals exist only here the sheet is not offered: an alert instead — settings.libraries.remove.refused.portrait.svg.
